gizmo.title: Pūnaewele kaiaola
gizmo.description: He pūnaewele launa e hōʻike ana pehea e pili ai nā ʻāpana o kekahi papahana, me nā pūnaewele lalo a me nā huakaʻi ʻanuʻu ma ʻanuʻu.

configure.title: ʻIkepili pūnaewele
configure.description: URL o ka pūʻolo JSON o nā pūnaewele (kūkulu ʻia ma PRAW, ecosystem-webs.json).

configure.title: Pūnaewele
configure.description: Id o ka pūnaewele e hōʻike mua ai; ʻo main ka pūnaewele kaiaola.

configure.title: Kile i koho ʻia
configure.description: Id o kekahi kile e koho ai ke wehe ka pūnaewele.

configure.title: Huakaʻi
configure.description: Id o kekahi huakaʻi e hoʻomaka ai.

configure.title: Hoʻomaka ma ka nānaina papa inoa
configure.description: Hōʻike i ka pūnaewele ma ke ʻano he mau papa inoa pūnana ma kahi o ke kaha kiʻi.

configure.title: Kaha kiʻi wale nō
configure.description: Hōʻike i ke kaha kiʻi wale nō, ma ke ʻano he kiʻi: ʻaʻohe poʻo, nā huakaʻi, nā kikoʻī a i ʻole ka pahu ʻanuʻu.

advanced.title: Heluhelu ma
advanced.description: Hoʻomaka me nā kile a pau i heluhelu ʻia ma hoʻokahi ana.
